{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents using the wrong package manager (npm vs pnpm, pip vs uv) and gives them the right command.","id":"gh:1420637437","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-enforce-package-manager","slug":"acus9345/dsh-enforce-package-manager","topics":["ai-agents","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","package-manager","pnpm","uv"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness plugin that stops agents using the wrong package manager (npm vs pnpm, pip vs uv) a"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nd gives them the right command."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-enforce-package-manager"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Your repo uses pnpm, and the agent types `npm install zod`. Now you've got a `package-lock.json` sit"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ting next to `pnpm-lock.yaml`, and a dependency that pnpm doesn't know about. On the Python side it'"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"s `pip install requests` in a uv project. The package lands in the venv, never reaches `pyproject.to"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"ml`, and vanishes on the next `uv sync`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"This DeepSeek Harness plugin works out which package manager the project uses. If the agent reaches "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"for a different one, the command is stopped and the model gets the right command, already translated"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"or a different one, the command is stopped and the model gets the right command, already translated:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The model usually just runs the suggested line next."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"That's the `web` profile, the browser UI you start with `dsh web`. If you run DSH another way, use `"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"headless` (scripts and CI) or `acp` (editor integrations) instead. Each profile keeps its own plugin"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" list, so add it to every profile you use. Nothing else to set up. Remove it with `dsh plugin --prof"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"ile web remove dsh-enforce-package-manager`."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### From a clone"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"To try local changes, build a tarball and install that:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## How it detects the project's manager"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"It starts in the directory the command will run in, following any `cd` earlier in the same command l"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"ine. From there it walks up and stops at the first directory that answers the question. It never goe"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s above the git root, or above the folder you started DSH in when there's no git repo, so a stray lo"},{"id":"p15s4","text":"ckfile in your home folder doesn't count."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"For JavaScript, a `packageManager` field in `package.json` wins. After that it looks for a single lo"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ckfile: `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `yarn.lock`, `bun.lock` / `bun.lockb` or `package-lock.json`. If it finds "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"lockfiles from two different managers, it doesn't guess and stays out of the way."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For Python it looks for `uv.lock`, `poetry.lock`, `pdm.lock`, `Pipfile`, or a `[tool.poetry]` / `[to"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ol.uv]` / `[tool.pdm]` section in `pyproject.toml`. A project with only `requirements.txt` has no ma"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"nager to enforce, so pip is left alone there."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## What gets translated"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"| The agent runs | In a pnpm project | In a uv project |"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| `npm install` | `pnpm install` | |
| `npm ci` | `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` | |
| `npm i -D v"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"itest` | `pnpm add -D vitest` | |
| `yarn add zod` | `pnpm add zod` | |
| `npm uninstall left-pad` |"},{"id":"p20s3","text":" `pnpm remove left-pad` | |
| `pip install httpx` | | `uv add httpx` |
| `python -m pip install -e ."},{"id":"p20s4","text":"` | | `uv sync` |
| `pip uninstall httpx` | | `uv remove httpx` |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The same goes for yarn, bun and npm projects, and for poetry (`poetry add`), pipenv (`pipenv install"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"`) and pdm (`pdm add`)."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Folder and workspace options carry over too. `npm i -w web react` becomes `pnpm --filter web add rea"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ct` (or `yarn workspace web add react`), and `npm install --prefix api` becomes `pnpm -C api install"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"` (or `yarn workspace web add react`), and `npm install --prefix api` becomes `pnpm -C api install`."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"On Windows, where DSH runs commands through PowerShell, the same checks apply to `npm.cmd`, `pip.exe"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"`, full program paths and `Set-Location`."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"It only cares about commands that change the project's dependencies. `npm run build`, `npm test`, `n"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"px vitest` and global installs (`npm i -g ...`) pass, because they don't touch the project's lockfil"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"e. On the Python side, `pip install --user ...` and upgrading the installers themselves (`pip instal"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"l -U pip`, `pip install uv`) are left alone for the same reason."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The easy way: open **Plugins** in DSH's sidebar, click **dsh-enforce-package-manager**, change what "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"you want and press **Save**. It applies to the next tool call, no restart needed."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Or add a row like this to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`, or to `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.y"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ml` for every profile. Keys you leave out keep their defaults."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"The install test runs `dsh plugin add`, which needs `pnpm` on your PATH."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"MIT licensed. Written by acus9345. Bug reports and ideas are welcome in the issues."}],"truncated":false}
